technical-summary: Added a read-only sealed-descriptor native fleet inspection entry to the matched Radiance executable. Compiled NativeFleetConfig once into rad_core, propagated the header to the executable, validated strict snapshot bytes/root and upstream fleet support, and emitted an admission-focused report without YAML or credentials. Added focused patch ordering, parser, seal, digest and root coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Added a card-free way for the matched Radiance engine to inspect the exact admitted YAML snapshot and report the settings BigCherry needs for admission.
